newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst John McMillin said Friday he had raised his earnings estimates for General Mills Inc to $3.10 a share from $3.05 for fiscal 1997. His fiscal 1998 estimate remains $3.40 a share.
-- McMillin said his rating on the cereal and food company remains hold.
-- On Thursday General Mills reported stronger than expected second quarter earnings of $1.00 a share, up from $0.92 a year ago and above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.95.
-- General Mills shares were down 1/4 at 65-3/8.
